12INT. CASTLE BATTLEMENTS - NIGHT12

Wind tears at the torches. HAMLET stands alone, staring into the dark.

HAMLET

(whispering)

Angels and ministers of grace defend us! Be thou a spirit of health or goblin damn'd, bring with thee airs from heaven or blasts from hell?

The GHOST beckons.

GHOST

Mark me.

HAMLET

I will.

THUNDER.

GHOST

My hour is almost come, when I to sulphurous and tormenting flames must render up myself.

HAMLET

Alas, poor ghost!

(MORE)

HAMLET (CONT'D)

Speak; I am bound to hear.

CUT TO:

13INT. CASTLE - GREAT HALL - DAY13

CLAUDIUS

But now, my cousin Hamlet, and my son —

HAMLET

(aside)

A little more than kin, and less than kind.

GERTRUDE (O.S.)

Good Hamlet, cast thy nighted colour off.
